previousCandidateRejectReason: StrictMode rejected normal module results whose data object did not expose the optional reboot control status property.
rc2RejectReason: Non-compliant components were marked Completed without invoking public payload installers.
rc3RejectReason: Legacy OpenWebUI Image Pack ownership was rejected instead of migrated, and the transaction omitted the component error.
rc4RejectReason: The Agent Pack branch overwrote the Complete Installer PackageRoot and made the following Visual Pack payload path invalid.
rc5RejectReason: StrictMode rejected missing optional desktop-link hashtable keys during finalization; top-level phase evidence and direct operations rollback were also missing.
rc6RejectReason: The code-interpreter finalizer still required the obsolete image-only tool binding and lacked automatic rollback.
rc7RejectReason: Validation Gate 1.0.2 rejected the Complete Installer because its release validation contract was missing and safe rootless legacy nested payloads were incorrectly treated as single-root errors.
rc8RejectReason: The Complete Installer marked Validation Gate 1.0.3 Completed without deploying its payload; installed current remained 1.0.2.
rc9RejectReason: The plan trusted the stale components.json value 1.0.3 and skipped the real Gate upgrade although current/VERSION remained 1.0.2.
rc10RejectReason: Target validation showed that Nomic and an unrelated LM Studio model remained selectable as chat models because the OpenWebUI connection model_ids allowlist was not deployed.
rc11PreliminaryRejectReason: The preliminary RC11 Agent Pack still recognized only the obsolete image-pack 1.9.0 metadata and removed both Visual Pack 2.0.5-rc1 tool bindings; the corrected RC11 uses Agent Pack 1.8.5 and component-wide rollback evidence.
rc12RejectReason: ComfyUI 1.2.3 did not persist its version marker after content deployment, referenced an uninitialized payload test during reconciliation, and did not roll back after failed real-version readback.
rc13RejectReason: The Agent Pack accessed Exception.Response without checking that the property existed, masking the underlying OpenWebUI API failure under StrictMode.
rc14RejectReason: The Complete Installer deployed Agent Pack before Visual Pack although Agent Pack requires the Visual Pack 2.0.5-rc2 tool metadata during pre-mutation readback.

rcBuildValidation.note: Evidence from the 2.5.0 cycle; carried forward as still valid for 2.6.0 since none of the installer-logic/build-pipeline code this script exercises changed in 2.6.0 (the 2.6.0 scope was RAG-module-only). Simulated empty target used for installer-logic validation; not a full physical Greenfield install.

ragLiveTargetValidation.scope: Execute (Add/Query/Replace/Remove) and Rollback of Add, Replace, and Remove all verified against a live OpenWebUI 0.11.0 instance with before/after remote evidence, each including a repeated Rollback call confirmed as a clean idempotent no-op.
ragLiveTargetValidation.regressionFinding: A partial-failure-then-retry regression test for the Replace/Remove restore path (added 2.6.0 AP01, mirroring the pre-existing Add-path scenario) found a real defect: a retry could re-issue a remove call against remote content an earlier partial attempt had already deleted, failing the retry itself. Fixed in Remove-RAGRemoteEntry to treat an already-removed target as already-satisfied, matching the real server's own behavior; negative-control verified.

greenfieldAcceptance.cycle: 2.5.0 -- carried forward as still valid for 2.6.0; no installer/build code changed in 2.6.0 (RAG-module-only scope), so no new Greenfield run was performed this cycle.
greenfieldAcceptance.environment: Hyper-V VM, fresh Windows install, no prior KI-Stack state
greenfieldAcceptance.visualAndAgentPackStatus: WaitingForUserAction -- expected credential state because no OpenWebUI administrator API key was supplied by design, not an installation failure

findings.description: Receive-Artifact issued a Range request starting at the already-complete artifact's end-of-file offset (Range: bytes=<ExpectedSize>-) whenever a fully-downloaded .partial file had not yet been moved to its final target, and the source correctly answered HTTP 416 Range Not Satisfiable. Fixed: a .partial file already at the exact expected size is now verified directly via the existing size/SHA256 contract, issuing no HTTP request; a hash mismatch fails safely through the existing invalid-artifact contract, never a silent reuse.
